eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CHILD ABDUCTION EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Brazos; Burleson; Grimes; Leon; Madison; Robertson; Washington, TX; at 1:46 PM on AUG 17, 2022 Effective until 4:46 PM AUG 21, 2022. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
The Bryan Police Department requests broadcast of the following information:

Ana Medina is a 7 year old Hispanic Female with Brown hair and Brown eyes. 

Ana Medina was last seen in the area of 700 block of Scott and White Drive in College Station, Brazos County, TX.  

The suspect is described as being a Hispanic Male, Pedro Angel Aranda Jimenez, who currently has a warrant issued for his arrest related to this incident. 

The suspect and child were last seen in a white 2005 Dodge Durango 
with license number HBY0222.  They are believed to be fleeing the area toward the US-Mexico border.  

If you have any information regarding this child abduction, please contact the Bryan Police Department at 979-209-5300.
